name: Facet
text: Use a live-updating, scrollable timeline at the top of the interface to show the sequence of actions and decisions as they happen. This keeps visibility high by making progress visible in real time, which improves clarity and enjoyment. The trade-off is screen space—we’re giving up some room for other controls, but the benefit of seeing the full flow outweighs the cost.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The live timeline risks overwhelming users with noise if decisions pile up fast—it trades clarity for liveness. A better alternative: a collapsible "Recent Activity" panel that only expands on demand, keeping the main view clean while still offering visibility. Settle it by testing both with real data: measure how often users open the panel versus how often they ignore the timeline.
